lines.en: label otohaspring6:
scene otohaamiwalk1
: So, before we all part ways, I’d like to thank each and every one of you for not making dinner inherently miserable. That went way better than I would have expected. You two get along weirdly well.
lines.zh: : 那么，在大家各奔东西之前，我要感谢你们每一位，没让这顿晚餐变得彻头彻尾的难受。比我预想的好太多了。你们俩相处得出奇地融洽。

lines.en: : Me and Otoha have a lot in common actually! So much that I think {i}she{/i} should move in too!
lines.zh: : 其实我和 Otoha 有很多共同点！多到我觉得{i}她{/i}也该搬进来！

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk2
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : In fact, why doesn’t {i}everybody{/i} move in?! If we’re going to be allowing non-family into the place, we might as well stop excluding everybody {i}else{/i} who wants to fuck my dad! The more, the merrier!
lines.zh: : 事实上，为什么{i}大家{/i}不都搬进来？！既然都要允许非家庭成员进那屋子了，那干脆就别把其他{i}任何{/i}想操我爸的人排除在外了！人越多越热闹！

lines.en: : Well, at least she waited until dinner was over.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少她还等到了晚餐结束。

lines.en: : I feel like it would be an act against my character right now if I were to not clarify once more that I do not want to have sex with your dad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，如果我现在不再澄清一次"我并不想和你爸上床"，那就太不符合我的人设了。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk3
: Oh, sorry. Is he too old?
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。是他太老了吗？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk4
: Anyway! I’ll be leaving now. But thanks for the food. And...trying to indoctrinate me into your family. Tonight was definitely everything I thought it was going to be and more.
lines.zh: : 总之！我要走了。不过谢谢这顿饭。还有……谢谢你们试图把我灌输进你们家。今晚绝对和我想象的一模一样，甚至更甚。

lines.en: : Don’t walk back alone, please. Ami will go with you.
lines.zh: : 请别一个人走回去。Ami 会陪你。

lines.en: : I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk5
: Akira and I have some adult things to do. Don’t we, Akira?
lines.zh: : Akira 和我有些大人的事要做。对吧，Akira？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...yeah. Like paying bills and other boring stuff that teenagers definitely shouldn’t be involved in because they’re not old enough.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……对。比如付账单，还有其他青少年绝对不该掺和的无聊事，因为他们还不够大。

lines.en: : Great job, babe. They’re totally convinced now.
lines.zh: : 干得好，亲爱的。她们现在完全信了。

lines.en: : Can we pay the bills doggy style tonight?
lines.zh: : 我们今晚能用后入式付账单吗？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk6

: Anyway! {i}We’ll{/i} be leaving now! But thanks for coming and getting indoctrinated into our dysfunctional fucking family. Do not, under any circumstances, come to our house over the next twelve hours.
lines.zh: : 总之！{i}我们{/i}要走了！不过谢谢你们过来、被灌输进我们这个失能的该死家庭。接下来十二小时之内，无论任何情况都别来我家。

lines.en: : We have so many bills.
lines.zh: : 我们有好多账单。

lines.en: : Akira, do you ever go to sleep at night proud of who you are?
lines.zh: : Akira，你晚上睡觉的时候，有过为自己这个人感到骄傲的时候吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : I guess you and I can head back to the dorms then, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 那么，Otoha，我想你和我可以回宿舍了吧？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk7
: What, you’re not going to try and stop them? This is like the perfect opportunity for some sort of temper tantrum about how Niki will never love him the way you can.
lines.zh: : 什么，你不打算拦着他们？这可是个绝佳的机会，你大可以发一通脾气，说 Niki 永远不可能像你那样爱他。

lines.en: : Meh. I have plenty of opportunities for that. I just think it’s important that Aunt Niki gets her space tonight so she never fully abandons the idea that there can be moments of comfort in this life!
lines.zh: : 嗯。这种机会我有的是。我只是觉得，今晚给 Niki 阿姨留点空间很重要，这样她就永远不会彻底放弃"人生里也能有片刻慰藉"这个念头！

lines.en: : It’d be really boring if she just gave up!
lines.zh: : 她要是就这么放弃了，那也太无聊了！

lines.en: : Ami, if I didn’t have so many bills to pay, I would ground you right now.
lines.zh: : Ami，要不是我有一堆账单要付，我现在就禁你足。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk8
: Can you ground me doggy style at least?
lines.zh: : 那你至少能用后入式禁我足吗？

lines.en: : Does this family know any other positions or is that the only one?
lines.zh: : 这家人还知道别的姿势吗，还是就只有那一种？

lines.en: : Maybe Niki can rescind her command that we leave her alone so we can all go back to my place and try out a bunch of new ones?
lines.zh: : 要不 Niki 收回"让我们别烦她"的命令，这样我们就能全都回我家，试一堆新姿势？

lines.en: : On second thought, I think I might just go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 再想想，我觉得我干脆去睡觉好了。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk9
: Wait, Niki-
lines.zh: : 等等，Niki——

lines.en: : Can’t hear you! Too busy not wanting to pay the bills anymore!
lines.zh: : 听不见！我正忙着不想再付账单了呢！

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk10
: Damn it, Ami. Look what you’ve done now.
lines.zh: : 该死，Ami。看看你干的好事。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk11
: So remember a little earlier when I asked if you could take it easier on Niki and that she’s sort of falling apart?
lines.zh: : 还记得刚才我问你能不能对 Niki 温和一点、说她快撑不住了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, why?
lines.zh: : 记得，怎么了？

lines.en: : Well, I just think that you should take it a little easier on Niki because she’s sort of falling apart.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我只是觉得你应该对 Niki 再温和一点，因为她快撑不住了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry. They’re still totally going to have sex. In fact, the two of them have even {i}more{/i} sex whenever she’s angry. I think she does it as a coping mechanism.
lines.zh: : 哦，别担心。他们照样会上床的。事实上，她一生气，那俩人上床的{i}次数{/i}反而更多。我觉得她是拿这个当应对机制。

lines.en: : And Akira doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 那 Akira 不是吗？

lines.en: : Well, it’s okay when he does it. He’s a boy.
lines.zh: : 嗯，他这么做就没关系。他是男孩子。

lines.en: : I have cameras if you want to watch. My dad tried to get rid of them all, but I hid one inside of some robot toy Io made for him and he doesn’t know about that one yet.
lines.zh: : 我有摄像头，你想看的话可以。我爸想把那些全丢掉，但我把一个藏在了 Io 给他做的机器人玩具里，那个他到现在还不知道。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk12
: How are you this fucking crazy, Ami? Like, you’ve never seemed {i}normal{/i} on account of the whole...familial clinginess thing...but I didn’t think you were an actual psychopath.
lines.zh: : Ami，你他妈怎么能疯成这样？我是说，因为那种……对家人的依恋……你从来就没{i}正常{/i}过，但我没想到你是个真正的精神变态。

lines.en: : Psychopath? That’s harsh. And totally untrue too. Psychopaths are super antisocial and here {i}I{/i} am walking home with a classmate who I’ve never really been alone with before. Sounds pretty social to me, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 精神变态？这话太重了。而且完全不符合事实。精神变态患者是极度反社会的，可{i}我{/i}现在正跟一个以前从没单独相处过的同学一起走回家。听起来挺社会的啊，Otoha。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re looking for my stamp of approval just because I may or may not read your mom’s poetry, you’re not going to get it. I never knew any of that stuff was {i}real.{/i} I thought she was just saying shit.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你以为我会因为自己可能读、也可能没读过你妈的诗就给你盖章认可，那你可要失望了。我从来不知道那些东西是{i}真的{/i}。我以为她只是在瞎说。

lines.en: : She was at the end. But if you read any of that stuff, you probably wouldn’t be questioning why I am the way I am, now would you?
lines.zh: : 到最后她确实是在瞎说。不过你如果读过哪怕一点那些东西，大概就不会问我为什么是现在这个样子了，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk13
: How you {i}are{/i} doesn’t really matter to me. I just don’t want you hurting the people I care about. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 你{i}是什么样子{/i}对我来说其实不重要。我只是不想让你伤害我在乎的人。就这些。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} to hurt {i}anybody,{/i} Otoha. Plus, you’re best friends with Nodoka and she hurts people for her own benefit all the time.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不想要{/i}伤害{i}任何人{/i}，Otoha。再说了，你跟 Nodoka 是最好的朋友，而她为了自己的好处伤害别人的次数可不少。

lines.en: : “Friends” isn’t really the first word I’d use to describe us. We’re more like...two misguided robots who fell out of a delivery truck and now exist to infinitely try and complete our respective missions.
lines.zh: : "朋友"可不是我用来形容我们的第一个词。我们更像是……两台从送货卡车上掉下来的、被误导的机器人，现在存在的意义就是无止境地试图完成各自的任务。

lines.en: : Yeah, and {i}I’m{/i} the same way. There’s a thing I need to do and I’m going to do it no matter what obstacles appear before me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，{i}我{/i}也是这样。有一件事我必须去做，无论面前出现什么障碍，我都要做成。

lines.en: : I guess it’s easier when I at least vaguely understand what Nodoka is trying to do.
lines.zh: : 我想，至少在我隐约明白 Nodoka 想做什么的时候，事情会容易一点。

lines.en: : Which is what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那具体是什么呢？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk14
: {i}That{/i} I don’t think I can say. Both because I don’t know if she’d want me to and because I’d probably suck at explaining it as a whole.
lines.zh: : {i}那个{/i}我大概不能说。一来我不知道她愿不愿意我说，二来我大概也没本事把整件事解释清楚。

lines.en: : It’s probably not what you think, though. Especially if you assume she’s only hurting people for her own benefit. Nodoka’s not like that, crazy as that sounds.
lines.zh: : 不过大概不是你想的那样。尤其是如果你以为她只是为了自己的好处才伤害别人的话。Nodoka 不是那种人，听着虽然很扯。

lines.en: : But I am?
lines.zh: : 那我是？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk15

: I don’t know, Ami. But when I see someone I respect as much as Niki being essentially walked all over by a girl even smaller and younger than me, I can’t help but wish things were a little different.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Ami。可当我看到像 Niki 那样我尊敬的人，被一个比我还矮、还小的女孩踩在脚下，我就忍不住希望事情能稍微不一样一点。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even touching on the stranglehold you have on Akira. You could cut that guy’s limbs off and he’d still refuse to give up on you. It’s just like how Niki is with {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这还没算上你死死拿捏着 Akira 的那股劲儿。你就是把那家伙的四肢砍下来，他也照样不肯放弃你。就像 Niki 对{i}他{/i}那样。

lines.en: : Do you think you’ll ever love somebody that much, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你有朝一日也会那么深地爱上某个人吗，Otoha？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk16
: Me? Why?
lines.zh: : 我？为什么这么问？

lines.en: : It’s just, even when you were dating Rin, you seemed like you were just in it for the fun of everything.
lines.zh: : 只是，就连你跟 Rin 交往的时候，你看起来也只是为了好玩而已。

lines.en: : And I’ve heard that {i}tons{/i} of people confessed to you at your old school. You’d think at least {i}one{/i} of them would interest you, right?
lines.zh: : 而且我听说你在以前的学校有{i}一大堆{/i}人跟你告白。你总该觉得至少有{i}一个{/i}能让你有点兴趣吧？

lines.en: : I...{i}hope{/i} I can find someone that does one day? I don’t know. Nothing’s really clicked yet. And right now, the only person I’ve ever felt that way about-
lines.zh: : 我……{i}希望{/i}有一天能找到一个让我有那种感觉的人？我不知道。到现在还没有什么真的对上过。而现在，唯一一个让我有过那种感觉的人——

lines.en: : Just say her name. I know it’s Niki.
lines.zh: : 说出她的名字就行。我知道是 Niki。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk17
: Ooooooof course you do.
lines.zh: : 哦——————你当然知道。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, {i}I{/i} ship you guys together. A famous idol two-timing her childhood friend with the teenage girl she’s giving vocal lessons to? I’d read, like...a hundred volumes of that.
lines.zh: : 不管你怎么想，{i}我{/i}是支持你俩这一对的。一个知名偶像背着青梅竹马的男人，跟自己正在教声乐的少女搞在一起？这种我能读上一百卷。

lines.en: : Well, unfortunately for both of us, that’s just not in the cards.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可惜对我们俩来说，这事根本不在牌面上。

lines.en: : What if it {i}could{/i} be, though?
lines.zh: : 可万一它{i}能{/i}成呢？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk18
: Whaaaat...are you implying exactly?
lines.zh: : 什————么……你到底在暗示什么？

lines.en: : Like, what if there was a world out there where you {i}got{/i} what you wanted? That you and Niki wound up together. Wouldn’t you want to see it?
lines.zh: : 比如，万一存在那么一个世界，在那里你{i}得到{/i}了自己想要的？你和 Niki 最后在一起了。你不想看看吗？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}obviously.{/i} But that’s not something I’m going to try and force into existence out of my own personal selfishness.
lines.zh: : 我意思是……{i}当然想{/i}。但那不是我会出于一己私利硬去把它变成现实的东西。

lines.en: : Just wanting to be happy is selfish now?
lines.zh: : 只是想要幸福现在也算自私了？

lines.en: : It is when it involves robbing other people of theirs.
lines.zh: : 当它意味着要抢走别人的幸福时，就算。

lines.en: : Well, that’s why I mentioned a different world. One where {i}everybody{/i} gets their wish. And you can rest easy knowing you haven’t stolen anything from anybody.
lines.zh: : 嗯，所以我才说另一个世界。一个{i}每个人{/i}都能实现愿望的世界。而你也可以安心，知道自己没有从任何人那里偷走任何东西。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk19
: Then sure. In this made-up scenario where I can mysteriously swap worlds and get everything I want without hurting anyone, yes. I would gladly indulge myself in that.
lines.zh: : 那当然。在这个我能神秘地换世界、得到一切想要的、又不伤害任何人的虚构设定里——是的。我会很乐意纵容自己。

lines.en: : I’d need a lot more than the hot older girl I’m into to like me back in order to make me feel {i}fulfilled,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过，光是让我喜欢的那个火辣年长女孩也喜欢我，还不足以让我感到{i}满足{/i}。

lines.en: : We can throw in a cute little brother or two if that makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 要是能让你开心，我们可以附送一两个可爱的弟弟。

lines.en: : I want to play at the Budokan as well. And have a single hit top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100.
lines.zh: : 我还想在武道馆演出。还要有单曲冲进公告牌百强单曲榜前十。

lines.en: : You could have the best-selling album of the year for all we know. I can’t see into your dreams.
lines.zh: : 说不定你还能拿年度销量冠军专辑呢。我又看不见你的梦。

lines.en: : But if I {i}could,{/i} I’d take you by the hand and force you to look at them. Like, {i}really{/i} look at them. Because we take our dreams for granted sometimes. I know I did.
lines.zh: : 可如果{i}能{/i}看见，我会牵着你的手，逼你去看它们。就是……{i}认真{/i}地去看。因为我们有时候把自己的梦当成理所当然。我知道我就这么干过。

lines.en: : And great things come from understanding what you {i}can{/i} have if you just put your best foot forward. Things you’re more familiar with than you know.
lines.zh: : 而伟大的东西，来自你理解了只要全力以赴，自己{i}能{/i}拥有什么。那些东西你比自己以为的更熟悉。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk20
: You’re a fucking weird girl, Ami. Like, what’s even the point of this weird, rhetorical rant?
lines.zh: : 你真是个他妈的怪女孩，Ami。你这段奇怪的、修辞味十足的长篇大论，到底想说什么？

lines.en: : There are a few points, Otoha!
lines.zh: : 有好几个点呢，Otoha！

lines.en: scene black
: The first is me trying to show you I’m not some evil super-villain who only exists to sow discord and make everyone you love unhappy.
lines.zh: : 第一，我想让你看到，我不是什么只会散播不和、让你爱的每个人都不开心的邪恶反派。

lines.en: : The second is to find out more about {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 第二，是想多了解{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Why, though? We were practically strangers until a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 可是为什么？直到不久之前，我们基本上还是陌生人。

lines.en: : Heh! We were, weren’t we? But still...
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们之前确实是，不是吗？不过……

lines.en: : I just needed to know you were you.
lines.zh: : 我只是需要确认，你就是你。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk21
: Well, it’s been...
lines.zh: : 嗯，今晚真是……

lines.en: : Well, it’s definitely been.
lines.zh: : 嗯，确实是"真是"了。

lines.en: : Anything planned for the rest of the night?
lines.zh: : 今晚剩下的时间有什么安排吗？

lines.en: : Just writing. Maybe a shower. Instagram. Why?
lines.zh: : 写点东西。也许洗个澡。刷刷 Instagram。怎么了？

lines.en: : Just wondering.
lines.zh: : 随便问问。

lines.en: : Also, why did you follow me up here? Your dorm is on the first floor. Your mission is complete. Go home.
lines.zh: : 还有，你干嘛跟着我上来？你的宿舍在一楼。你的任务完成了。回家吧。

lines.en: : Do you want to, like...I don’t know...maybe hang out a little more?
lines.zh: : 你要不要……我不知道……也许再待一会儿？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk22
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhh...whyyyyy?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……为————什么？

lines.en: : You sound a little...put-off by that.
lines.zh: : 你听起来有点……被吓到了。

lines.en: : Sorry. I just wasn’t expecting it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是没料到。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk23

: We don’t have to if you feel weird about it. I just...don’t get many chances to talk to people about my mom’s poetry and...I figured sharing that with another fan might be kinda...I don’t know...fun, I guess?
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得别扭，我们大可不必。我只是……很少有机会跟别人聊我妈妈的诗，而且……我想，和另一个粉丝分享这些，也许会挺……我不知道……挺好玩的，大概？

lines.en: : But you’re right. It’s weird. And I’m probably already annoying you, so-
lines.zh: : 不过你说得对。这挺怪的。而且我大概已经在烦你了，所以——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk24
: No, I’m...not {i}annoyed.{/i} I just didn’t even think I was going out to dinner with you and Akira tonight and now it’s like I really {i}am{/i} being indoctrinated into the Arakawa drama circle.
lines.zh: : 不，我……没有{i}烦{/i}。我只是没想到今晚我会跟你和 Akira 出去吃饭，现在倒像是我真的{i}被{/i}灌输进荒川家的狗血圈子里了。

lines.en: : I can avoid that sort of drama if you don’t like it. I just want to...learn more about what you like and share poems and stuff. I hear you’re really good. You know my dad used to write too, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你要是不喜欢这种狗血，我可以避开。我只是想……多了解你喜欢什么，一起分享诗什么的。我听说你很厉害。你知道我爸以前也写东西的，对吧？

lines.en: : I...yeah, I’ve...I’ve heard about that.
lines.zh: : 我……嗯，我……我听说过。

lines.en: : Then...maybe just for a little while? I feel kind of weird in my dorm room when Maya isn’t there. Unless Nodoka would be opposed to me bothering you guys or something.
lines.zh: : 那么……也许就待一会儿？Maya 不在的时候，我待在自己宿舍房间里总觉得怪怪的。除非 Nodoka 会反对我去打扰你们什么的。

lines.en: : Nodoka’s at her mom’s tonight, so...it’ll be just you and me if...that’s cool?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 今晚在她妈妈那儿，所以……就你和我，如果……可以的话？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk25
: Very cool! I-
lines.zh: : 太可以了！我——

lines.en: : {i}Shh!{/i} Io and Touka get pissed when people are making noise too late up here.
lines.zh: : {i}嘘！{/i} Io 和 Touka 会生气，这么晚在楼上吵。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk26
: Oh! Sorry, I...I’m really only ever up here to play D&D with Molly, so...
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉，我……我上楼来基本只跟 Molly 一起跑团，所以……

lines.en: : It’s...fine. Just...hurry up and get inside before anybody sees us.
lines.zh: : 没……事。只是……赶紧进去，别让人看见我们。

lines.en: : You’re making it sound like we’re here to hook up.
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，听起来像是我们来这儿是为了勾搭。

lines.en: scene black
: Then get inside at a reasonable pace at which no one will think I’m bringing you here for sexual purposes!
lines.zh: : 那就用一个合理的速度进去，让谁都不会以为我把你带上来是为了性！

lines.en: : Poor Rin. I wonder what she’d think if she saw us?
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Rin。不知道她要是看到我们会怎么想？

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god, just get-
lines.zh: : 哦我他妈的上帝啊，你给我——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk27
: Oh, wow! So {i}this{/i} is what it’s like in here. I’ve always wondered.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇！{i}里面{/i}原来是这个样子。我一直很好奇。

lines.en: : It’s...a room. That much is certainly...factual.
lines.zh: : 这是个……房间。这一点倒是确实……很客观。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk28
: You’ve got a lot of Bandori posters. Is Yukina your fav? That, like, totally tracks.
lines.zh: : 你有很多 Bandori 的海报。你最喜欢 Yukina 吗？这完全说得通。

lines.en: : Huh? Uhh...yeah. You...you’re into that too?
lines.zh: : 哈？呃……嗯。你……你也喜欢那个？

lines.en: : I’ve got a PasuPare poster right next to my bed. I spent like half of my last paycheck on the new Aya UR. Roselia’s good too, though! I like Sayo the most in that group. She reminds me a little of Maya.
lines.zh: : 我床边就贴着一张 PasuPare 的海报。我上个月的工资有一半花在了新的 Aya UR 上。Roselia 也不错！那个团里我最喜欢 Sayo。她让我想起一点 Maya。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk29

: Like, Makinami. Not to be confused with Maya from PasuPare. I just realized it was probably a little confusing mentioning real-life Maya in the same conversation I’m talking about the existence of a fake Maya.
lines.zh: : 我是说，Makinami。别跟 PasuPare 的 Maya 搞混了。我刚意识到，在同一场对话里提到现实中的 Maya，又提到一个虚构的 Maya，可能有点让人糊涂。

lines.en: : No, I...knew what you meant. That’s cool, though. I guess we do have some stuff in common after all.
lines.zh: : 不，我……知道你指的是谁。不过那挺酷的。看来我们毕竟还是有些共同点的。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk30

: {size=-2}Oh, tons, I’m sure! Like, we both like Bandori. We both like Niki’s music. We both like The Girl Who Cannot Breathe. And we’d both totally go down on my dad if divine magic suddenly turned him into a little kid again!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}哦，肯定有一大堆！比如，我们都喜欢 Bandori。我们都喜欢 Niki 的音乐。我们都喜欢《无法呼吸的女孩》。而且要是神圣魔法突然把我爸变回小孩子，我们俩都会毫不犹豫地给他口交！{/size}

lines.en: : Wait one-
lines.zh: : 等一下——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk31
: How do you feel about parfaits? I can get you a free one if you come to the maid cafe during my next shift. I normally work-
lines.zh: : 你觉得芭菲怎么样？下次我上班的时候你来女仆咖啡厅，我可以免费给你一个。我一般——

lines.en: : Ami! {i}Chill.{/i} And cut it out with the fucking shotacon shit.
lines.zh: : Ami！{i}冷静。{/i} 还有别再他妈提正太控那套了。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk32
: {i}Sorry. I’ll keep my voice down. So, what is it about them that you like? Fictionally, of course. Did you go to any of those sites I sent you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉。我会小声点。那么，你喜欢它们哪一点？当然是虚构意义上的。我发给你的那些网站，你去了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : I...may have...clicked on a couple of them for...research purposes...
lines.zh: : 我……可能……点开了几个，为了……研究目的……

lines.en: : You’re bi, right? Cause if you’re into loli stuff as well, I have a totally different site for that. If it’s just boys, I get it, though. Older sister fantasies are tough to contend with, huh?
lines.zh: : 你是双性恋，对吧？因为如果你也喜欢萝莉那类的，我有个完全不同的网站。不过如果只是男孩子，我能理解。姐姐幻想确实很难对抗，是吧？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk33
: Ami, I really do not like this line of questioning if we’re being completely honest.
lines.zh: : Ami，说实话，我真的很不喜欢你这串问题。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I guess it’s probably weird to talk about this with somebody you’re not close to, huh? My bad. I’m just so used to doing it with Maya that I kinda forgot me and you weren’t as close yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。跟一个不熟的人聊这个，大概确实挺怪的吧？我的错。我太习惯跟 Maya 聊这些了，都忘了我和你还没那么熟。

lines.en: : It’s fine, I-
lines.zh: : 没事，我——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk34
: Wait, {i}Maya?{/i} Really?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}Maya？{/i} 真的？

lines.en: : Oh, God yeah. She’s not really into shotas, but she reads a ton of loli doujinshi. I think it’s a projection thing because she’s so small. I just like it because I like anything socially unacceptable.
lines.zh: : 哦，天啊，当然真的。她不算喜欢正太，但她读了成堆的萝莉同人志。我觉得那是一种投射，因为她个子太小了。我喜欢，纯粹是因为我喜欢一切社会不接受的东西。

lines.en: : This is...good information that I will definitely not do anything with or about.
lines.zh: : 这是……很有用的信息，我绝对不会拿它做任何事。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk35
: So, like, sorry if this is rude and feel free to not answer if you don’t want to, but are you only uncomfortable talking about this stuff because it’s not all fiction to you?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果这问题很失礼你可以不回答，但你之所以聊这些会不舒服，是不是因为对你来说那不全都是虚构的？

lines.en: : Like, I know what I said a few minutes ago, but would you or would you not {i}actually{/i} get with some little boy if you knew you could? And how young would you go exactly? What’s the cut-off?
lines.zh: : 比如，我知道你几分钟前说了什么，但如果你知道自己{i}可以{/i}，你到底会不会真的跟某个小男孩在一起？具体来说，你能接受到多小？底线在哪儿？

lines.en: : I knew I should not have invited you in here.
lines.zh: : 我就知道不该让你进来。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk36
: It’s so sad, right?! That some people have to go their whole lives without being able to do anything about their greatest desires?!
lines.zh: : 这多可悲啊，对吧？！有些人一辈子都没法对自己最强烈的欲望做任何事？！

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk37

: Or they could be like my mom. And capitalize on those desires anyway because they’re far more nuanced than society thinks, right? Her greatest sin was loving the wrong person. How fair is that? Huh?
lines.zh: : 或者他们可以像我妈一样。反正就靠着那些欲望赚钱，因为它们比社会以为的复杂得多，对吧？她最大的罪过，就是爱错了人。这公平吗？啊？

lines.en: : Do you have a favorite poem of hers? I probably know it by heart if you do. Give me the first line and I’ll give you the rest.
lines.zh: : 你有最喜欢她哪一首诗吗？你有的话我大概能背出来。你给我第一行，我给你接下去。

lines.en: : How would Akira feel hearing you talk about all of this, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami，Akira 要是听到你说这些，会怎么想？

lines.en: : Depends on the light. He changes every day. Sometimes, he’d probably cry. Others? He’d probably close his eyes and wish he were right back in bed with her.
lines.zh: : 取决于光线。他每天都在变。有时候，他大概会哭。有时候？他大概会闭上眼睛，希望自己此刻还跟她躺在床上。

lines.en: : They were in love and you know it. You {i}want{/i} it. And you’ve always wanted something like that. But you feel guilty because the world tells you that’s not how you’re {i}supposed{/i} to feel.
lines.zh: : 他们曾经相爱过，这你知道。你{i}想要{/i}那种东西。而且你一直想要那样的东西。可你觉得愧疚，因为世界告诉你，你{i}不该{/i}有那种感觉。

lines.en: : Who cares, though? Why would you when there’s another world out there where everything is completely the opposite?
lines.zh: : 可谁在乎呢？既然外面还有另一个世界，那里的一切都完全相反，你又何必在乎？

lines.en: : Morals are decided by humans and humans are stupid. So why have we decided they’re all just right about {i}this?{/i} How can just twenty-four hours separate a normal person from a pariah?
lines.zh: : 道德是由人决定的，而人是愚蠢的。那我们凭什么就认定他们在{i}这件事{/i}上全都是对的？二十四小时怎么能就把一个正常人变成贱民？

lines.en: : This is all just my take, though. Like, I wouldn’t think any less of you if you {i}did{/i} have a little brother you were {i}bathing{/i} with every night for extended periods of time. You know?
lines.zh: : 不过这些都只是我的看法。比如，就算你真的有个每天晚上跟你一起{i}洗澡{/i}、洗很久的弟弟，我也不会因此看低你。你知道吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever felt this...I don’t know. {i}Ashamed{/i} before?
lines.zh: : 我大概从没这么……我不知道。这么{i}羞耻{/i}过。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk38
: I don’t want to {i}shame{/i} you, Otoha. I {i}get{/i} it. It’s {i}hard{/i} liking things the world decided you’re not {i}allowed{/i} to like. We both grew up on that concept.
lines.zh: : 我不想{i}让你羞耻{/i}，Otoha。我{i}懂{/i}。喜欢这个世界判定你{i}不许{/i}喜欢的东西，是{i}很难{/i}的。我们俩都是在这种观念里长大的。

lines.en: : All I did was read. It’s just...I’ve been talking so much shit on Akira from the start for the way he treats our class just to...be hiding something like this about {i}myself.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我做的只是读书而已。只是……我从一开始就在拼命骂 Akira 对待我们班的方式，结果……{i}自己{/i}却藏着这样的事。

lines.en: : If he ever found out, I wouldn’t even be able to look at him anymore. Especially knowing that he’s the literal product of what happens when fiction stops being {i}just{/i} fiction.
lines.zh: : 万一他发现了，我连看都不敢再看他一眼。尤其是想到，他自己就是"虚构不再{i}只是{/i}虚构"时结出的那个实实在在的产物。

lines.en: : Can I propose something super weird?
lines.zh: : 我能提一个超级怪的建议吗？

lines.en: : I mean, you’re already fucking calling me out on everything else you’ve managed to pick up about me tonight. Why stop now?
lines.zh: : 反正你今晚已经把我身上被你察觉到的东西挨个儿点出来了。干嘛现在停下？

lines.en: : If you really want a little brother, you can treat {i}me{/i} like one.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想要个弟弟，你可以把{i}我{/i}当弟弟。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk39
: I’m sorry. What?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。什么？

lines.en: : Think about it! {i}You{/i} don’t have any siblings. {i}I{/i} don’t have any siblings. {i}You{/i} want to groom a little boy. {i}I{/i} like power dynamics, age gaps, and illicit contact between family members.
lines.zh: : 你想想！{i}你{/i}没有兄弟姐妹。{i}我{/i}也没有兄弟姐妹。{i}你{/i}想调教一个小男孩。{i}我{/i}喜欢权力关系、年龄差，以及家庭成员之间的禁忌接触。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk40
: Plus, even training bras are too big for me sometimes!
lines.zh: : 再说，有时候连训练胸罩对我来说都太大了！

lines.en: : I’m basically already {i}built{/i} like a little boy. Just throw a strap-on on me and I’m pretty much the perfect way for you to get what you want without feeling the wrath of society!
lines.zh: : 我基本上{i}天生{/i}就长得像个小男孩。给我戴个假阳具，我简直就是让你得到想要的、又不必承受社会怒火的最佳方案！

lines.en: : Ami, aren’t you straight?
lines.zh: : Ami，你不是异性恋吗？

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk41
: Yeah, why?
lines.zh: : 是啊，怎么了？

lines.en: : Because I’m a girl.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个女孩。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’d be the boy in this scenario. Did you miss that part?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可在这个设定里我是那个男孩。你漏掉那部分了？

lines.en: : Holy shit. You {i}did{/i} come in here to hook up with me.
lines.zh: : 我操。你还{i}真的{/i}是进来跟我勾搭的。

lines.en: : I mean, I figured it was {i}possible.{/i} You don’t seem that excited, though. I thought this was a great idea.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我觉得{i}有可能{/i}。不过你看上去不怎么兴奋。我本来还以为这是个好主意呢。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk42
: Like, seriously. There’s just nothing there. When are they supposed to start growing? Because I feel like it should have happened already.
lines.zh: : 说真的，那儿什么都没有。它们到底该什么时候开始长？我觉得早该长了才对。

lines.en: : Yeah...uhh...
: I think I’m...gonna go make a phone call really quick.
lines.zh: : 我想我……得赶紧去打个电话。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk43
: Otoha? Right now? Really?
lines.zh: : Otoha？现在？真的？

lines.en: : Yup. Just a quick one. Be back in a second.
lines.zh: : 对。很快就好。马上回来。

lines.en: : Well, what am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 那我该干什么？

lines.en: : {i}Don’t know. Be back shortly. Bye.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不知道。很快回来。拜。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk44
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : You’re missing out, though. Because, between the washboard and the short hair, I really {i}am{/i} just like the boys you’ve been fingering yourself to.
lines.zh: : 不过你可亏大了。因为就凭这块搓衣板和这头短发，我{i}真的{/i}跟你一直对着自慰的那些男生一模一样。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk45
: And that’s not even touching on my acting skills.
lines.zh: : 这还没算上我的演技。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohaamiwalk46
: Wow. What a nice desk.
lines.zh: : 哇。好漂亮的桌子。

lines.en: : It’d sure be terrible if somebody suddenly ruined everything both inside of and on top of it.
lines.zh: : 要是有人突然把桌子里和桌上所有的东西都毁了，那可真是糟透了。

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk47
: Hi. It’s me. Come get your daughter before she turns into your son.
lines.zh: : 嗨。是我。趁你女儿还没变成你儿子，快来把她领走。

lines.en: : {i}You know, I expected a call from you, but those are not the words I anticipated hearing once I answered.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我就知道你会打来，但接起来之后会听到这几个字，我可没料到。{/i}

lines.en: : She’s freaking me the fuck out, dude. Like, she not only knows certain shit about me that nobody but {i}Nodoka{/i} knows, but the way she’s talking about it makes me think she’s even crazier than you are.
lines.zh: : 她快把我吓死了，老兄。她不只是知道一些除了{i}Nodoka{/i}之外没人知道的关于我的事，而且她说起那些事的口气，让我觉得她比你还要疯。

lines.en: : {i}That’s my girl, alright.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不愧是我的女儿。{/i}

lines.en: : And you’re just totally fine with that?
lines.zh: : 而你就这么完全无所谓？

lines.en: : {i}Absolutely not. But if you think there’s anything I can do about her, you’re wrong. I’m at my wit’s end, Otoha. Here’s Niki.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}绝对不是无所谓。可你要是以为我能拿她怎么样，你就错了。我已经束手无策了，Otoha。Niki 接了。{/i}

lines.en: : No, I don’t want to talk to Niki. I-
lines.zh: : 不，我不想跟 Niki 说话。我——

lines.en: : {i}Otoha? What did that fucking parasite do now? And make it quick. I’m trying to pay my bills.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Otoha？那个该死的寄生虫又干了什么？长话短说。我正忙着付账单呢。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk48
: {i}Hah...{/i}nothing, Niki. Everything’s totally a-okay over here and you can go back to your {i}finances{/i} without having to worry about it. I’ve got it under control.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}没什么，Niki。这边一切都好得很，你回去管你的{i}财务{/i}就行了，不用操心。我hold得住。

lines.en: : {i}Are you sure? Because I dragged you into this. Which means I can try to drag you out but that it probably won’t work because, like Akira said, nothing will work and I’m at my wit’s end too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你确定？因为是我把你拖下水的。也就是说我可以试着把你拖出来，但那大概没用，因为就像 Akira 说的，什么办法都没用，我也束手无策了。{/i}

lines.en: : Yup. I’ve got it. See you next weekend.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我hold得住。下周见。

lines.en: : {i}Oh, maybe just try acting like an older sister or something? That’s what Noriko tries to do, but Noriko’s fed up with her now too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，也许你可以试试表现得像个姐姐什么的？Noriko 就是这么做的，不过 Noriko 现在也受够她了。{/i}

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk49
: I feel like that is the actual worst thing I could do in this case. Good-
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样做在这件事里大概是下下策。好——

lines.en: : {i}AAAH! YOU FUCKING...WARN ME FIRST, ASSHOLE!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊！你这该死的……下次先警告我一声啊，混蛋！{/i}

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk50
: Night...
lines.zh: : 晚安……

lines.en: scene black
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Sorry, but I think it’s time you-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过我觉得你该——

lines.en: scene otohaamiwalk51
: Oh.
scene black
: Yup.
: Should have known that was a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 早该知道那是个坏主意。
